excerpt.zh: 我们终于摆脱了吃力不讨好的监管人职位！让其他随便什么人去担心这帮忘恩负义的家伙们的未来吧。
excerpt.en: Finally we are rid of the thankless and futile Custodianship! Let someone else worry about the future of this ungrateful galaxy.

texts.zh: 我们终于摆脱了吃力不讨好的监管人职位！让其他随便什么人去担心这帮忘恩负义的家伙们的未来吧。
texts.en: Finally we are rid of the thankless and futile Custodianship! Let someone else worry about the future of this ungrateful galaxy.

texts.zh: [former_custodians.GetName]提前结束了他们在星海共同体中的监管人任期。似乎他们并不愿意承担监管人的责任。
texts.en: The [former_custodians.GetName] has prematurely ended their term as Custodians of the Galactic Community. It seems the responsibilities of the Custodianship weren't to their liking.

label.zh: 我们已经尽我们所能了。

tooltips.en: The [From.GetName] are no longer Custodians of the Galactic Community.
The [From.GetName] are no longer Custodians of the Galactic Community.

title.zh: 泛星系防卫军暂停行动

texts.zh: 由于星海监管人的职位现在空缺，泛星系防卫军设立了一个独立的指挥架构。他们依然致力于保护星海共同体，泛星系防卫军的指挥高层宣誓将继续巡逻成员国的恒星系。
texts.en: With the office of the Galactic Custodian now vacant, the Galactic Defense Force has established an independent command structure. They remain dedicated towards the protection of the Community, and GDF High Command has vowed to maintain their patrols of member systems.

label.zh: 他们的警觉令人肃然起敬。
